entry.title: M400 Version 3.1.0 Available
entry.content:
• Significantly reduced the detection of speech by people not wearing the device, often referred to as "cross-talk". This correction applies to applications that internally request the "voice_recognition" audio configuration.
  • Increased the sensitivity of the microphones in applications that internally request the "Camcorder" audio configuration.
  • Corrected an issue that prevented the camera from operating from certain third-party applications.
  • Improved compatibility to certain Mobile Device Manager (MDM) platforms.

entry.title: Shield Version 1.1.0 Available
entry.content:
• Creates ability for 3rd party developers to control the depth of content on the screens using the standard Android API.
  • Adds support for the Vuzix Companion App running on Android and iOS phones to the Shield glasses.
  • Adds the Quick Start application to train new users on the device features and operation.
  • Adds support for Mobile Device Management (MDM) software including zero-touch provisioning.
  • Adds network setup to the first-time user experience.
  • Improves the image quality in the waveguide.
  • Improves the responsiveness of the touchpad.
  • Improves the audio tuning.
  • Improves 3rd party app support in the built-in barcode scanner.
  • Improves readability in certain system screens.
  • Updates Android security patches to compliance with the February 2024 bulletin.

entry.title: Blade 2 Version 1.2.0 Available
entry.content:
New Features

  • Adds the Quickstart training application.
  • Adds a default Text-to-speech engine for accessibility.

Reliability

  • Improves memory management to increase 3rd party application performance and reliability.
  • Solves intermittent display lock-up.

Wi-Fi

  • Improves Wi-Fi roaming.
  • Allows WPA3 security to be configured from the Companion app.
  • Allows Wi-Fi direct connections to phones running Android 14.
  • Allows locking Wi-Fi to 2.4 or 5 GHz networks.

Regulatory

  • Adds South Africa and Korea to the regulatory e-label.

Mobile Device Manager

  • Increased compatibility to certain Mobile Device Manager (MDM) software packages.

System

  • Updates MicroG GmsCore to version 0.2.29.33013 and Store to version 0.2.1.
  • Updates Chromium Webview to version 119.0.6045.66.
  • Applied security patches to bring the Blade2 OS up to compliance as of the December 2023 bulletin.
    • For more information on these security bulletins, refer to the official Android Security Bulletin page here.

entry.title: Blade 2 Version 1.1.1 Available
entry.content:
Accessibility

  • Added the sub-menu Settings > Personal > Accessibility. This allows easier access to the standard Android accessibility options.
  • Added Pico TTS as the default speech to text engine. This engine will be used by the accessibility services and other 3rd party applications whenever a custom speech to text engine is not installed.

Custom Launchers

  • Added the ability for 3rd party systems to set the default system launcher. This allows third-party software developers to customize the primary experience on the glasses.

entry.title: Blade 2 Version 1.1.0 Available
entry.content:
Languages

  • Adds support for four additional languages. The available options are now:
    • Chinese (simplified and traditional script, Mandarin and Cantonese dialect)
    • English
    • German
    • Japanese
    • Korean
    • Spanish

Keyboard

  • Increased the available symbol set on the soft keyboard.

PDF Viewer

  • The PDF Viewer has been updated for usability improvements.
  • The folder in which to place PDFs is now "/sdcard/Documents/PDFs" and any files already stored in the previous "PDF Viewer" folder will no longer be visible. Existing PDF files must be manually moved.

Mobile Device Manager

  • Increased compatibility to certain Mobile Device Manager (MDM) software packages.

Wi-Fi

  • Improved the flow of the Wi-Fi captive portal sign on process.

System

  • Applied security patches to bring the Blade2 OS up to compliance as of the February 2023 bulletin.

entry.title: M400 Version 3.0.2 Available
entry.content:
• Upgrades to Android 11.0 (Android R).
  • Supports WPA3 Wi-Fi security.
  • Allows easier integration to certain Mobile Device Management (MDM) software packages.
  • Updates built-in application icons.
  • Displays numeric bubbles to be used as speech input for any application that is not optimized with a custom vocabulary. Simply say "Hello Vuzix", and if bubbles appear say the desired number to click buttons and fields on the user interface.
  • Improves OLED performance. The screen will now automatically turn off when the device is not being worn. This can be disabled from Settings > Display > Burn-in protection.
  • Updates Android security patches to compliance with the December 2022 bulletin.

entry.title: M400 Version 2.6.0 Available
entry.content:

entry.title: M400 Version 2.4.0 available
entry.content:
• Adds an option to display numeric bubbles which are used as speech input. Enable this from Settings > Accessibility > On-screen speech bubbles. Many applications that could not otherwise be controlled using speech commands will then be capable of using speech to click various buttons and fields.
  • Adds ability to unlock the numeric PIN screen lock using speech input. Say "Hello Vuzix" on the PIN screen lock to associate randomized words with each button.
  • Improves the speech recognition ability to recognize certain phrases.
  • Improves reliability of the over-the-air software update service. 
  • Allows the built-in PDF viewer to navigate with explicit head motion gestures.
  • Improves the ability to get location from Wi-Fi networks and the Companion App.
  • Removes the clock application icon from the carousel launcher.
  • Corrects compatibility to certain Bluetooth Low-Energy Human Interface Devices. 
  • Enables Remote Network Driver Interface Specification (RNDIS).
  • Updates Chromium Webview to version 96.0.4664.92.
  • Updates MicroG GmsCore to version 0.2.22.212658.
  • Updates Android security patches to compliance with the December 2021 bulletin.
    • For more information on these security bulletins, refer to the official Android Security Bulletin page here.

entry.title: M400 Version 2.3.0 available
entry.content:
• Updates the built-in speech command recognition engine.
    • Improves the detection accuracy in certain environments.
    • Adds new option to adjust the speech command pronunciation tolerance. This can be changed from Settings > System > Languages & input > Speech Commands > Pronunciation tolerance.
    • Adds new option to prevent the device from waking using speech commands so it always require a physical button push. This can be changed from Settings > System > Languages & input > Speech Commands > Listen while asleep.
    • Adds the Cantonese dialect to speech command recognition. This can be selected from the preferred language list upon first boot by selecting: 中文(繁體中文,香港). This may also be set from Settings > System > Languages & input > Languages > Add a language.
    • Queries to the Vuzix speech command SDK now return phrases in sentence case instead of lowercase.
  • Enables 5 GHz Wi-Fi frequencies 5250-5730 in the U-NII-2 band. Now all 5 GHz channels from 36 through 165 are available.
  • Adds new option to limit Wi-Fi bands to either 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz for specific instances where this is required. This can be changed from Settings > Network & internet > Wi-Fi > Wi-Fi frequency band.
  • Improvements to the Wi-Fi roaming behavior for certain enterprise configurations.
  • Enabled certain application notifications to be displayed in a system window that allows the user to properly interact with the buttons.
  • Allows location to be received from the companion application on a linked smart phone.
  • Automatically sets the time zone upon network connection. This feature may be disabled and the time zone set manually from Settings > System > Date & time.
  • Updates Android security patches to compliance with the August 2021 bulletin.
    • For more information on these security bulletins, refer to the official Android Security Bulletin page here.

entry.title: Vuzix Blade® OS Version 2.14 - Release Notes
entry.content:
Display

  • Created a new option under Settings > Device > Display to allow the user to turn off the display without putting the device to sleep.
  • Requires use of the mouse pointer.
    • Select "Mouse" mode under Settings > Device > TouchPad > Mode to use the touchpad as a mouse or use the companion app's virtual trackpad.

microG

  • microG is an open-source implementation of Google Play Services and is now available on Blade OS.
  • miroG settings can be found under Settings > System > microG Settings

Barcode Scanning

  • Scan barcodes directly from the Blade home screen.

entry.title: M400 Version 2.2.0 available
entry.content:
• Improves Wi-Fi throughput on certain networks.
  • Adds pop-up to open Wi-Fi captive portal settings, and allows the touchpad to optionally control mouse pointer on the captive portal.

  • Allows certain customizations to persist across factory resets.
  • Updates Chromium WebView to v91.0.4472.101.

entry.title: Vuzix Blade® OS Version 2.13 - Release Notes
entry.content:
Touchpad and Gestures

  • Allows the touchpad to be used as a mouse pointer. Enable this by selecting "Mouse" mode in Settings > Device > Touchpad.
  • Usage:
    • Swipe with one finger to move the cursor.
    • Tap with one finger to click the screen at the cursor.
    • Swipe with two fingers to scroll the view.
    • Tap with two fingers to go back.
  • Adds settings:
    • Touchpad Mode.
    • *Pointer Speed.
    • *Invert Pointer X-Axis.
    • *Invert Scroll X-Axis.
  • Adds Touchpad Mode setting to power menu.

PDF Viewer App

  • Adds a default PDF viewer to handle system file view requests.
    • Open PDFs by selecting the file in the PDF Viewer app.

Wi-Fi

  • 802.11 Roaming improvements.

GPS

  • Updates to GPS logic to support Google Maps when using Companion Location.

Audio and Speech Recognition

  • Provides better interactions with BT headphones and Assistants.

 OTA and Recovery

  • Improved the OTA process while system is in Japanese

System

  • Localization updates.
  • Bug fixes.

Developers

  • Updates HudResources.
  • Updates HudActionMenu.

*Applies to Mouse mode only.

entry.title: M400 Version 2.1.1 available
entry.content:
• Allows the device location to be determined by the companion app running on an iOS or Android smartphone.

  • Adds a default PDF viewer to handle system file view requests.

    • ​Open PDFs by selecting them from Downloads or Files.

  • Adds a user setting to invert the touchpad.

    • Enable this from Settings > System > Languages & input > Invert Touchpad X Axis.

  • Ensure ADB debugging is off unless explicitly enabled from Settings > Connected devices > Allow ADB.

  • Solves certain audio issues introduced in v2.0.0 regarding headset microphones.

  • Updates Chromium Webview to v89.0.4389.86.

entry.title: M400 Version 2.1.0 available
entry.content:
• Allows the touchpad to be used as a mouse pointer. Enable this by selecting "Mouse" mode in Settings > System > Language & input > Touchpad.
    Usage:
    • Swipe with one finger to move the cursor.
    • Tap with one finger to click the screen at the cursor.
    • Swipe with two fingers to scroll the view.
    • Tap with two fingers to go back.
  • Tapping the touchpad will no longer wake the device. Pressing any physical button still wakes the screen.
  • Adds compatibility to some third-party USB battery packs.
  • Adds Mexico, Australia, New Zealand, and Taiwan to M4000 regulatory e-label.
  • Updates Android security patches to compliance with the February 2021 bulletin.
    • For more information on these security bulletins, refer to the official Android Security Bulletin page here.

entry.title: Vuzix Blade® OS Version 2.12 - Release Notes
entry.content:
Bluetooth

  • Added support for phone call audio when paired as a headset.

Companion

  • Added file management support from the Vuzix Companion app on both Android and iOS.

Wi-Fi

  • Added 802.1x EAP Wi-Fi support.
  • Added option to join Wi-Fi via QR code scan.

Audio and Speech Recognition

  • Added Speech Recognition to soft keyboard.
  • Improved interaction between Speech Recognition and virtual assistants.
  • Reduced navigation feedback click by 15 dB.

Camera App

  • Improved Barcode scanning.

System/Developer Improvements

  • Added support for Speech to Text.
  • Added PIN lock option.
  • Update to Speech Recognition v.1.91.
